statement: The closed-form scale attains the shape-and-power profile and bounds every other positive scale.
hypotheses_and_conclusion:
(hn : 0 < n) (x : Fin n → ℝ) {k p : ℝ}
    (hk : 0 < k) (hp : 0 < p) :
    TransformedGamma.logLik x k p (TransformedGamma.scale x k p) = scaleProfile x k p ∧
      ∀ a > 0, TransformedGamma.logLik x k p a ≤ scaleProfile x k p

statement: The conditional shape is the unique positive inverse-digamma-gap fit for each fixed positive power.
hypotheses_and_conclusion:
(hn : 0 < n) {x : Fin n → ℝ} (hx : ∀ i, 0 < x i)
    (hne : ∃ i j, x i ≠ x j) {p : ℝ} (hp : 0 < p) :
    ∃! k : ℝ, 0 < k ∧ UnivariateML.Gamma.scoreGap k =
      UnivariateML.Gamma.jensenGap (TransformedGamma.powerSample x p) ∧
      IsMaxOn (fun t ↦ scaleProfile x t p) (Ioi 0) k

statement: The powered Jensen gap grows at the mean log distance from the sample maximum, with ties allowed.
hypotheses_and_conclusion:
(hn : 0 < n) (x : Fin n → ℝ) (j : Fin n)
    (hj : ∀ i, log (x i) ≤ log (x j)) :
    Tendsto (fun p : ℝ ↦
      UnivariateML.Gamma.jensenGap (TransformedGamma.powerSample x p) / p) atTop
      (𝓝 (log (x j) - UnivariateML.Gamma.avgLog x))

statement: The fitted profile tends to the optimized power value at infinite power.
hypotheses_and_conclusion:
(hn : 0 < n) (x : Fin n → ℝ) (j : Fin n)
    (hj : ∀ i, log (x i) ≤ log (x j))
    (hD : 0 < log (x j) - UnivariateML.Gamma.avgLog x)
    {k : ℝ → ℝ} (hk : ∀ p > 0, 0 < k p)
    (hs : ∀ p > 0, UnivariateML.Gamma.scoreGap (k p) =
      UnivariateML.Gamma.jensenGap (TransformedGamma.powerSample x p)) :
    Tendsto (fun p ↦ scaleProfile x (k p) p) atTop
      (𝓝 (log (log (x j) - UnivariateML.Gamma.avgLog x)⁻¹ -
        UnivariateML.Gamma.avgLog x - 1))

statement: Every sufficiently large power has a uniform upper envelope at the fitted power value plus arbitrary slack.
hypotheses_and_conclusion:
(hn : 0 < n) {x : Fin n → ℝ} (hx : ∀ i, 0 < x i)
    (hne : ∃ i j, x i ≠ x j) (j : Fin n) (hj : ∀ i, log (x i) ≤ log (x j))
    {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∀ᶠ p : ℝ in atTop, ∀ k > 0, ∀ a > 0,
      TransformedGamma.logLik x k p a <
        log (log (x j) - UnivariateML.Gamma.avgLog x)⁻¹ -
          UnivariateML.Gamma.avgLog x - 1 + ε

statement: The squared-power-normalized Jensen gap tends to half the log variance.
hypotheses_and_conclusion:
(hn : 0 < n) {x : Fin n → ℝ}
    (hx : ∀ i, 0 < x i) (hne : ∃ i j, x i ≠ x j) :
    Tendsto (fun t : ℝ ↦
      UnivariateML.Gamma.jensenGap (TransformedGamma.powerSample x t) / t ^ 2) (𝓝[>] 0)
      (𝓝 (UnivariateML.Gamma.avg (fun i ↦
        (log (x i) - UnivariateML.Gamma.avgLog x) ^ 2) / 2))

statement: The fitted lognormal height bounds the likelihood in a sufficiently small-power collar, uniformly over shape and scale.
hypotheses_and_conclusion:
(hn : 0 < n) {x : Fin n → ℝ} (hx : ∀ i, 0 < x i)
    (hne : ∃ i j, x i ≠ x j) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) :
    let V := UnivariateML.Gamma.avg (fun i ↦ (log (x i) - UnivariateML.Gamma.avgLog x)^2)
    ∀ᶠ t : ℝ in 𝓝[>] 0, ∀ k > 0, ∀ a > 0,
      TransformedGamma.logLik x k t a <
        -log (2 * π) / 2 - log V / 2 - 1 / 2 - UnivariateML.Gamma.avgLog x + ε

statement: A finite witness at or above both exterior heights implies a finite maximum, including equality.
hypotheses_and_conclusion:
(hn : 0 < n) {x : Fin n → ℝ} (hx : ∀ i, 0 < x i)
    (hne : ∃ i j, x i ≠ x j) (j : Fin n) (hj : ∀ i, log (x i) ≤ log (x j)) :
    let V := UnivariateML.Gamma.avg (fun i ↦ (log (x i) - UnivariateML.Gamma.avgLog x)^2)
    let N := -log (2 * π) / 2 - log V / 2 - 1 / 2 - UnivariateML.Gamma.avgLog x
    let P := log (log (x j) - UnivariateML.Gamma.avgLog x)⁻¹ -
      UnivariateML.Gamma.avgLog x - 1
    (∃ k > 0, ∃ t > 0, ∃ a > 0, max N P ≤ TransformedGamma.logLik x k t a) →
      ∃ k > 0, ∃ t > 0, ∃ a > 0, ∀ k' > 0, ∀ t' > 0, ∀ a' > 0,
        TransformedGamma.logLik x k' t' a' ≤ TransformedGamma.logLik x k t a

statement: The feasible-witness comparison is an equivalence on nonconstants, and the likelihood is unbounded on constants.
hypotheses_and_conclusion:
(hn : 0 < n) {x : Fin n → ℝ}
    (hx : ∀ i, 0 < x i) (j : Fin n) (hj : ∀ i, log (x i) ≤ log (x j)) :
    let V := UnivariateML.Gamma.avg (fun i ↦ (log (x i) - UnivariateML.Gamma.avgLog x)^2)
    let N := -log (2 * π) / 2 - log V / 2 - 1 / 2 - UnivariateML.Gamma.avgLog x
    let P := log (log (x j) - UnivariateML.Gamma.avgLog x)⁻¹ -
      UnivariateML.Gamma.avgLog x - 1
    ((∃ i j, x i ≠ x j) →
      ((∃ k > 0, ∃ t > 0, ∃ a > 0, ∀ k' > 0, ∀ t' > 0, ∀ a' > 0,
          TransformedGamma.logLik x k' t' a' ≤ TransformedGamma.logLik x k t a) ↔
        ∃ k > 0, ∃ t > 0, ∃ a > 0, max N P ≤ TransformedGamma.logLik x k t a)) ∧
    ((∀ i j, x i = x j) →
      ∀ C : ℝ, ∃ k > 0, ∃ t > 0, ∃ a > 0, C < TransformedGamma.logLik x k t a)
dossier_scope_note: Criterion, finite feasibility rather than finite stationary enumeration

statement: Reciprocity turns the large-power bound into the fitted Pareto upper envelope at the sample minimum.
hypotheses_and_conclusion:
{n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) {x : Fin n → ℝ} (hx : ∀ i, 0 < x i)
    (hne : ∃ i j, x i ≠ x j) (j : Fin n) (hj : ∀ i, x j ≤ x i)
    {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∀ᶠ p : ℝ in atTop, ∀ k > 0, ∀ a > 0,
      InverseTransformedGamma.logLik x k p a <
        log (Gamma.avgLog x - log (x j))⁻¹ - Gamma.avgLog x - 1 + ε

statement: Reciprocity transports the uniform small-power bound using the same log variance and the original-data Jacobian.
hypotheses_and_conclusion:
{n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) {x : Fin n → ℝ} (hx : ∀ i, 0 < x i)
    (hne : ∃ i j, x i ≠ x j) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) :
    let V := Gamma.avg (fun i ↦ (log (x i) - Gamma.avgLog x)^2)
    ∀ᶠ t : ℝ in 𝓝[>] 0, ∀ k > 0, ∀ a > 0,
      InverseTransformedGamma.logLik x k t a <
        -log (2 * π) / 2 - log V / 2 - 1 / 2 - Gamma.avgLog x + ε

statement: The witness comparison and constant branch transport to the inverse model with the correct two face heights.
hypotheses_and_conclusion:
{n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) {x : Fin n → ℝ}
    (hx : ∀ i, 0 < x i) (j : Fin n) (hj : ∀ i, x j ≤ x i) :
    let V := Gamma.avg (fun i ↦ (log (x i) - Gamma.avgLog x)^2)
    let N := -log (2 * π) / 2 - log V / 2 - 1 / 2 - Gamma.avgLog x
    let P := log (Gamma.avgLog x - log (x j))⁻¹ - Gamma.avgLog x - 1
    ((∃ i j, x i ≠ x j) →
      ((∃ k > 0, ∃ t > 0, ∃ a > 0, ∀ k' > 0, ∀ t' > 0, ∀ a' > 0,
          InverseTransformedGamma.logLik x k' t' a' ≤
            InverseTransformedGamma.logLik x k t a) ↔
        ∃ k > 0, ∃ t > 0, ∃ a > 0, max N P ≤ InverseTransformedGamma.logLik x k t a)) ∧
    ((∀ i j, x i = x j) →
      ∀ C : ℝ, ∃ k > 0, ∃ t > 0, ∃ a > 0, C < InverseTransformedGamma.logLik x k t a)
dossier_scope_note: Criterion, finite feasibility rather than finite stationary enumeration

statement: A normalized log-concave density bounds peak times distance by an affine function of the pointwise log loss.
hypotheses_and_conclusion:
{f : ℝ → ℝ} {m y : ℝ}
    (hconc : ConcaveOn ℝ univ f) (hm : f y ≤ f m)
    (hi : Integrable (fun z ↦ exp (f z)) volume)
    (hn : (∫ z, exp (f z)) = 1) :
    exp (f m) * |y - m| ≤ exp 1 * (1 + (f m - f y))

statement: Every nonconstant log-sample superlevel bounds the mode and bounds the peak above and away from zero.
hypotheses_and_conclusion:
{n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (y : Fin n → ℝ)
    (hne : ∃ i j, y i ≠ y j) (c : ℝ) :
    ∃ B M : ℝ, ∀ {f : ℝ → ℝ} {m : ℝ},
      ConcaveOn ℝ univ f → (∀ x, f x ≤ f m) →
      Integrable (fun z ↦ exp (f z)) volume → (∫ z, exp (f z)) = 1 →
      c ≤ (∑ i, f (y i)) / n → exp c ≤ exp (f m) ∧ exp (f m) ≤ B ∧ |m| ≤ M

statement: Reciprocating the data and scale swaps the held shape, with a sample-only log Jacobian.
hypotheses_and_conclusion:
{n : ℕ} {x : Fin n → ℝ} (hx : ∀ i, 0 < x i)
    {s : ℝ} (hs : 0 < s) (b p q : ℝ) :
    Shape2GB2.logLik (fun i ↦ (x i)⁻¹) s⁻¹ b (q, p) =
      Shape2GB2.logLik x s b (p, q) + ∑ i, 2 * log (x i)
dossier_scope_note: Criterion and failure, shape1 and shape3 transfer

statement: Normalized GB2 peaks and log modes obey uniform bounds on each nonconstant-sample superlevel.
hypotheses_and_conclusion:
{n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (y : Fin n → ℝ)
    (hne : ∃ i j, y i ≠ y j) (c : ℝ) :
    ∃ B M : ℝ, ∀ (v : ℝ) {a p q : ℝ}, 0 < a → 0 < p → 0 < q →
      c ≤ (∑ i, logDensity v a p q (y i)) / n →
      let m := v + log (p / q) / a
      exp c ≤ exp (logDensity v a p q m) ∧
        exp (logDensity v a p q m) ≤ B ∧ |m| ≤ M

statement: The original GB2 objective differs from the log-sample objective by the additive log Jacobian.
hypotheses_and_conclusion:
{n : ℕ} {x : Fin n → ℝ} (hx : ∀ i, 0 < x i)
    {s : ℝ} (hs : 0 < s) (a p q : ℝ) :
    Shape2GB2.logLik x s a (p, q) + ∑ i, log (x i) =
      ∑ i, logDensity (log s) a p q (log (x i))

statement: The density at any point is at most the harmonic combination of the two one-sided rates.
hypotheses_and_conclusion:
(v m : ℝ) {a p q : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (hp : 0 < p) (hq : 0 < q) :
    exp (logDensity v a p q m) * ((a * p)⁻¹ + (a * q)⁻¹) ≤ 1

statement: Both rates are bounded below by the exponentiated mean log-likelihood level. At either fixed beta shape this forces power away from zero.
hypotheses_and_conclusion:
{n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (y : Fin n → ℝ)
    {v a p q c : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (hp : 0 < p) (hq : 0 < q)
    (hlevel : c ≤ (∑ i, logDensity v a p q (y i)) / n) :
    exp c ≤ a * p ∧ exp c ≤ a * q

statement: With lower shape held, moving the scale below the limiting cutoff realizes the whole Pareto endpoint density at all ties.
hypotheses_and_conclusion:
{n : ℕ} (y : Fin n → ℝ) {p μ D : ℝ}
    (hp : 0 < p) (hD : 0 < D) (hy : ∀ i, μ ≤ y i) :
    Tendsto (fun a : ℝ ↦
      ∑ i, logDensity (μ - log a / a) a p (D / a) (y i)) atTop
      (𝓝 (∑ i, (log D - D * (y i - μ))))

statement: Reflection realizes the whole upper-cutoff power density at all ties with upper shape held.
hypotheses_and_conclusion:
{n : ℕ} (y : Fin n → ℝ) {q μ A : ℝ}
    (hq : 0 < q) (hA : 0 < A) (hy : ∀ i, y i ≤ μ) :
    Tendsto (fun a : ℝ ↦
      ∑ i, logDensity (μ + log a / a) a (A / a) q (y i)) atTop
      (𝓝 (∑ i, (log A - A * (μ - y i))))

statement: With lower shape fixed and upper shape diverging, positive limiting power and a finite limiting mode give the transformed-gamma trace.
hypotheses_and_conclusion:
{ι : Type*} {l : Filter ι} {n : ℕ}
    (y : Fin n → ℝ) {p a₀ m₀ : ℝ} (hp : 0 < p) (ha₀ : 0 < a₀)
    {a q m : ι → ℝ} (ha : Tendsto a l (𝓝 a₀))
    (hq : Tendsto q l atTop) (hm : Tendsto m l (𝓝 m₀)) :
    Tendsto (fun j ↦ ∑ i, logDensity (m j - log (p / q j) / a j) (a j) p (q j) (y i)) l
      (𝓝 (∑ i, (log a₀ + p * log p - log (Real.Gamma p) +
        p * a₀ * (y i - m₀) - p * exp (a₀ * (y i - m₀)))))

statement: The reflected moving limit gives the inverse transformed-gamma trace with upper shape held.
hypotheses_and_conclusion:
{ι : Type*} {l : Filter ι} {n : ℕ}
    (y : Fin n → ℝ) {q a₀ m₀ : ℝ} (hq : 0 < q) (ha₀ : 0 < a₀)
    {a p m : ι → ℝ} (ha : Tendsto a l (𝓝 a₀))
    (hp : Tendsto p l atTop) (hm : Tendsto m l (𝓝 m₀)) :
    Tendsto (fun j ↦ ∑ i, logDensity (m j - log (p j / q) / a j) (a j) (p j) q (y i)) l
      (𝓝 (∑ i, (log a₀ + q * log q - log (Real.Gamma q) +
        q * a₀ * (m₀ - y i) - q * exp (a₀ * (m₀ - y i)))))

statement: Translating to positive excesses preserves the entire objective in all three requested hold masks.
hypotheses_and_conclusion:
{n : ℕ} {x : Fin n → ℝ} {μ s : ℝ}
    (hx : ∀ i, μ < x i) (hs : 0 < s) (b : ℝ) (sh : ℝ × ℝ) :
    ShapeFacesFellerPareto.logLikelihood x μ b s sh =
      Shape2GB2.logLik (fun i ↦ x i - μ) s b sh

statement: The held-lower-shape Pareto path transports with the original-excess Jacobian and all tied contacts.
hypotheses_and_conclusion:
{n : ℕ} {x : Fin n → ℝ} {μ p D m : ℝ}
    (hx : ∀ i, μ < x i) (hp : 0 < p) (hD : 0 < D)
    (hm : ∀ i, m ≤ log (x i - μ)) :
    Tendsto (fun a : ℝ ↦ ShapeFacesFellerPareto.logLikelihood x μ a
      (exp (m - log a / a)) (p, D / a)) atTop
      (𝓝 ((∑ i, (log D - D * (log (x i - μ) - m))) - ∑ i, log (x i - μ)))

statement: The held-upper-shape power path transports with the original-excess Jacobian and all tied contacts.
hypotheses_and_conclusion:
{n : ℕ} {x : Fin n → ℝ} {μ q A m : ℝ}
    (hx : ∀ i, μ < x i) (hq : 0 < q) (hA : 0 < A)
    (hm : ∀ i, log (x i - μ) ≤ m) :
    Tendsto (fun a : ℝ ↦ ShapeFacesFellerPareto.logLikelihood x μ a
      (exp (m + log a / a)) (A / a, q)) atTop
      (𝓝 ((∑ i, (log A - A * (m - log (x i - μ)))) - ∑ i, log (x i - μ)))

    (sh : ℝ × ℝ) :
    Tendsto (fun a : ℝ ↦ ShapeFacesFellerPareto.logLikelihood (fun _ : Fin n ↦ x)
      μ a (x - μ) sh) atTop atTop
